h1: Sea La Vie Seaside Carriage House
meta_description: Why Guests Love This Carriage House• 60 yards to Tupelo Street Pavilion private beach access• Located in the highly sought-after Seaside Proper• Complimentary 2 bikes to explore 30A• Two bedrooms, each with a private en suite bathroom• Bright, designer interiors + high-end coasta
description_expanded: Why Guests Love This Carriage House• 60 yards to Tupelo Street Pavilion private beach access• Located in the highly sought-after Seaside Proper• Complimentary 2 bikes to explore 30A• Two bedrooms, each with a private en suite bathroom• Bright, designer interiors + high-end coastal finishes• Full kitchen, dining area, and comfortable living room• Private entrance + dedicated outdoor stairway• Professionally managed with 24/7 support• Snowbird-friendly (Jan–Feb monthly stays)• Minimum age to book: 25________________________________________About This SpaceWelcome to the Sea La Vie Carriage House, a stand-alone guest home in the heart of Seaside Proper. Ideal for two couples, small families, or guests seeking a cozy space, this carriage house offers elevated coastal style just steps from the Gulf.Enjoy a peaceful residential setting while being only a short walk from Seaside Square’s restaurants, food trucks, shops, and entertainment. Your private beach access at Tupelo Street Pavilion is just 60 yards away—making seaside living effortless.________________________________________The SpaceCarriage House (2BR • 2.5BA)First Floor• Open-concept living area• Dining space for four• Full kitchen with appliances, cookware, and essentials• Half bath (powder room)Second Floor• Bedroom 1: King Bed, en suite full bathroom• Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, en suite full bathroomNeed more space? This luxury residence can be booked together with Sea La Vie Seaside Main House, creating an exceptional Seaside estate ideal for extended families or groups. Please contact us for more info. If you are booking the carriage house only, please be aware that we may have guests enjoying the main house located at the front of the property during that time.________________________________________Guest AccessGuests have private access to:• Entire carriage house• Complimentary 2 bikes to explore 30A• Private exterior entrance + stairway• Two parking passes for off-street parking located throughout the neighborhoodImportant: The pool and spa belong to the Main House only and are not available to carriage house guests.Access to the Tupelo Street Pavilion private beach entrance is included for all guests.________________________________________Other Things to Note• Minimum age to book: 25• Snowbird rentals available January–February (monthly only)• Monthly bookings require an additional $150 cleaning fee• Seaside Proper community rules and quiet hours apply________________________________________The NeighborhoodLocated in Seaside Proper—one of the most iconic communities along 30A—you’ll enjoy walkable access to:• Seaside Square shops, dining, and events• Food trucks + local coffee spots• WaterColor and Grayton Beach• 30A’s bike-friendly pathways• Gulf-front pavilions and beach boardwalks• Kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing, nature trails, and snorkeling Read less
